content: पारक्य {%a.%} .²1 Alien, belonging to another; वरं स्वधर्मो विगुणो न पारक्यः स्वनुष्ठितः <ls>Ms. 10. 97</ls>; पारक्यस्यैव देहस्य बह्वपो मेऽक्षौहिणीर्हताः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 8. 48</ls>. .²2 Intended for others. .²3 Hostile, inimical. .²4 Useful in the next world. .{@-क्यः@} An enemy, adversary. .{@-क्यम्@} Doing anything for future happiness (परलोकसाधन); pious conduct.
